stem.text: The relative first ionisation energies of four elements with consecutive atomic numbers below 20 are shown on the graph.
One of the elements reacts with hydrogen to form a covalent compound with formula $\text{HX}$.

stem.alt: Graph of first ionisation energy (kJ mol-1) against atomic number for four points labelled A, B, C and D. B is highest, A is lower than B, C is much lower than B, and D is slightly higher than C.
